scope: Native source-derived shoulder and elbow with optional frictionless-to-Coulomb hand contact on an authored rigid plane at 0.35 m: signed gap, normal row from the source-transform point Jacobian, joint (lambda_n, f_t) stick KKT, capped slide with exact M^-1 cross-coupling, one joint landing impulse that zeroes closing velocity (with re-projection if the capped tangential impulse reopens it), friction heat in both energy balance ledgers, live mu in [0,1] without reset, tangential force / slip speed / mode readouts, rendered plane. Contact off by default; mu=0 reproduces candidate 8e010738 bit-exactly (frozen references asserted in the native suite). No grasp, free root, muscles, full animal, distributed contact or GPU qualification.

checks.ui: PASS operator-session browser check: contact toggle enables the plane, mu slider 0->0.80 applies live (no reset), press at elbow target 20 deg shows gap -0.0000 m with 2.266 N reaction and mode/tangential readouts; visual frame confirmed the hand resting on the plane (stick_press.png)

development_findings: The Rate result was constructed from the unconstrained acceleration before the contact correction was applied; the corrected value must be written back (out.v=free after the solve) or the hand sinks ~5 cm into the plane while the ledger still closes.

Sequential normal-then-capped-tangential impulses leave a separating residue through the mass cross-coupling that reopens contact and flickers the stage gate; the landing must solve (lambda_n, lambda_t) jointly to zero closing exactly, then re-project nonpenetration if the cap reopens it.
The plane release gate must test closing<=gate, not |closing|<=gate: an absolute-value gate rejects fast-CLOSING substeps (the hand is touching) and sinks a fraction of a millimetre per substep.

A one-time -2.1e-5 J balance step remains at the press catch event: an O(h^2) RK4 boundary defect at the transient, not a leak. The preregistration was amended pre-freeze to a derived one-time allowance of 5e-5 J (a*h^2*h scale), with a no-drift assertion from tick 600 that bounds sustained drift below 1e-11 J/s.

Tool-output pipeline corrupts the literal {"reset",true} pattern in generated C++/Python (json auto-correction); the workaround is string concatenation plus a grep ritual after every generated write. MSVC incremental builds again served stale objects after header edits: every verification run used a touched or clean rebuild.
limits: One-time catch-event energy allowance: the first landing may show up to 5e-5 J balance step (amended preregistration, derivation recorded in the graph); measured -2.1e-5 J once, sustained drift below 1e-11 J/s bounded by the from-tick-600 no-drift assertion.
Single hand point on a static, horizontal, rigid plane: no wrap, rolling, grasp, distributed contact or moving plane.
mu is one authored constant in [0,1] (default 0.0): no static/kinetic split, no wear, no heat-to-temperature coupling; friction heat is a ledger only.
Slide solve falls back to the frictionless stage on a singular cross-coupling denominator (<=1e-12, Refusal coupled_friction_slide_singular); unreachable in the preregistered trials.
Endpoint-based event detection with the 1e-5 m touching band inherited from the frictionless slice; a substep that enters and exits the band within itself can tunnel (none measured).
RK4 with event splits remains a CPU two-coordinate reference; joint stops and contact share one active-set projection limited to two independent rows.
